integrity: Analytic proof and reproducible standard-library numerical checker supplied. Finite tests do not establish infinite-parametric claims; independent audit and independent validation have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact theorem is confined to a four-cycle with two alternating strictly positive conductances, the spectral power of the combinatorial Laplacian, and its usual matrix-exponential semigroup; unequal-edge general cycles and time-fractional evolution are not covered. The equal-rate special case and general subunit-order positivity are existing results, with historical-priority uncertainty for the unequal-rate law.
title: Logarithmic positivity delay with vanishing amplitude in anisotropic four-cycle fractional heat
